summary: Regime-Lab backend workflow, guards, persistence, label plausibility, keep/build behavior, and regression APIs were tested against the public URL. Frontend admin login, Regime-Lab modal/detail/charts/config UI/WF result plus Optimizer and Backtester regressions were exercised. Backend: 9/12 tests passed; frontend tested flows passed.

critical.issue: Persisted analysis contains regime 0 labeled 'Seitwärtsmarkt' although stats.trend_strength is 1.18. This violates the required label invariant and propagates into the existing dynamic strategy. Newly created analyses use the corrected label logic, so stored analyses need migration/relabeling.
A regime marked kept=false is still included in the built dynamic strategy. Reproduced on ra_c8206904: after discarding combined regime 0, build returned regimes [0,1].

minor.issue: Missing regime_id returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of 400/422; backend log shows int(None) TypeError at regime_lab.py:134.

action_items: Migrate or relabel stored regime models using stats.trend_strength so old analyses and dynamic strategies obey the new label invariant.
Filter assignments by the analysis kept map in build and walk-forward/optimizer paths as documented; discarded regimes must not enter the generated strategy.
Validate regime_id before int conversion in keep (and similarly in assign) and return a controlled 400/422 response.
Retest the complete Regime-Lab workflow after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: regime_opt._assignment_items returns every assignment for a scope and never consults doc.kept; build and walk-forward therefore include discarded regimes.
start_regime_optimize also does not reject a discarded regime, despite the keep endpoint documentation saying discarded regimes are skipped during strategy search.
Regime-Lab request bodies are untyped Dict values; direct int(body.get('regime_id')) calls allow malformed requests to become 500 errors. Use Pydantic request models or explicit validation.

RegimeLab.js is 584 lines and combines list, analysis detail, regime cards, job polling, build, and walk-forward concerns; it is approaching the maintainability threshold and should be split before further expansion.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_Regime_Lab_QA analyses, optimizer/WF runs, TEST dynamic strategies, and generated base custom strategies. Temporary analyses/dynamic/custom strategies were cleaned up; pre-existing ra_c8206904, dyn_19a907e8, and custom_dd633f11 were preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The seeded ra_c8206904 remains the best frontend fixture and has two assignments plus saved WF. Full public-URL analyze→optimize→assign→walk-forward→build completed quickly in this environment. UI tests confirmed regime charts BTC/ETH, legend, cards, similarity, optimize configuration panel, build controls and saved verdict. Optimizer and Backtester modals still open.
rca_of_the_issue: Label defect: labels are materialized in MongoDB and old documents were not migrated when _label_de changed. Keep/build defect: keep only writes doc.kept, while _assignment_items filters solely by assignment key prefix and build consumes that unfiltered map. Validation defect: keep constructs its key with int(body.get('regime_id')) without checking for None or using a typed request schema.
flaky_tests: One unauthenticated analyze request transiently received a public-ingress 502; an immediate isolated retry passed with the expected 401. This was not counted as a product failure.
